title: MAPWise: Evaluating Vision-Language Models for Advanced Map Queries

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance on visual question answering tasks across maps of three different countries (USA, India, and China) to identify disparities in geographical representation and training data.

Evaluating and comparing model accuracy across different stylistic map variants representing the same underlying data, such as discrete vs. continuous maps, colored vs. hatched patterns, and maps with vs. without text annotations.

Testing models on counterfactual maps featuring imaginary state names, shuffled state names, and jumbled data values to measure the models' reliance on pre-trained internal knowledge (factual bias/hallucination) versus the provided visual evidence.
